entry.title: Open-Weight vs Closed-Weight Models: What's the Difference?
entry.summary: An open-weight model publishes its trained weights, so anyone can run, fine-tune or serve it. A closed-weight model is only available from its maker. We used a year of OpenRouter usage data, our price catalog and benchmark scores to show what that difference changes for cost, providers and quality.
